description: Retrieve one exact SVG icon using an exact ref returned by search_icons, recommend_icons, or preview_icons. Do not guess icon IDs. Use search_icons first if the user only described a concept. Returns SVG code, explicit public library labels, visual preview URL, and public semantic guidance for the exact icon.

id.description: Exact icon ID without the library prefix, for example "database", "user-circle", "brain-circuit", or "arrow-down".

library.description: Required library key for the exact icon. Supported values include si (Supericons AI and developer tool logos), lucide, tabler, phosphor, heroicons, bootstrap, iconoir, ionicons, material, simpleicons (Simple Icons brand logos), and mingcute.

style.description: Optional style preference. Material Symbols supports outline and solid. Other hosted libraries report their verified styles in list_libraries.

name: get_icon

code.description: Stable error code when the exact icon is unavailable.

error.description: Recoverable error message when no exact icon is found.

hint.description: Plain-language explanation of how to recover.

icon_preview_url.description: Browser URL for visual inspection of this icon.

icon_ref.description: Stable icon reference in library:id format.

id.description: Icon ID without the library prefix.

libraryName.description: Legacy camelCase public source library name.

library_key.description: Source icon library key repeated for explicit agent display.

library_label.description: Public source library label, for example Supericons (si).

library_name.description: Public source library name, for example Supericons or Simple Icons.

search_preview_url.description: Browser URL for visual inspection of the source search results.

semantic.description: Public semantic guidance for search and agent selection.

style.description: Icon style such as outline or solid.

svg.description: Inline SVG markup for the icon.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the same exact lookup may succeed.

title: Get Icon
